energy_accuracy.interpretation: Empirical successive-bond convergence supports the requested target; not a rigorous error bound.

occupation_resolution.interpretation: Adequate to assess the six-orbital screening boundary and the leading historical spectral differences; differences below these empirical resolutions are not individually resolved.

historical_comparison.interpretation: Chemically consistent construction and similar but measurably distinct occupation spectra. These diagnostics do not establish identical Hamiltonians or AO-space subspaces; historical AO coefficients and exact parent/localization details are unavailable. Orbital selection did not use energy matching.

compression.chemistry: First four K6 orbitals have predominant terminal-ligand S3p character; last two predominant bridging-S3p character, with Fe and other ligand mixing. Full shell weights are preserved.
compression.chemistry_occupation_provenance: The occupation entries in K6_character.json belong to the provisional density that defined the fixed basis. Final fixed-basis occupations are in compression_assessment.json.
compression.interpretation: The six orbitals pass the 1.97 occupation screen and are stable with bond dimension, but fixing them doubly occupied loses about 34.17 mEh. Thus this reduction is not an energy-preserving replacement at the current 1e-5 Eh solver scale. Deliver CAS14 as a quantitatively characterized compression experiment alongside the validated full/CAS20 reference. No application-specific acceptable-cost cutoff has been imposed. Sector weight is not fidelity with the reoptimized CAS14 ground state and does not predict future AFQMC bias.
compression.application_specific_utility: Undecided; future VCE/AFQMC study is outside this phase.
